title: Vertex
description: The last village, reduced to a floor and a few points of light. The Keeper offers one place without a quest. The Shape explains arriving. The Echo remembers every fight, including the ones the rules fought. The Absence does not speak, which is its contribution.

steps.text: Vertex was what remained once everything that could be taken away had been. A floor. A few points of light. Four residents, if you counted generously, and one of them would rather you didn't.

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: Most villages would ask where you came from. Vertex does not keep that kind of record.

lines.speaker: Fighter
lines.text: That's it? No quest? No warning?

lines.speaker: The Keeper
lines.text: You have had a great many of both. I thought you might like one place without either.

lines.speaker: The Shape
lines.text: You came in along an edge. Everyone does. There is no other way to reach a point.

lines.speaker: The Shape
lines.text: You will leave along one too. The direction will be different.

lines.speaker: The Echo
lines.text: I remember you. Every fight, even the ones you let the rules take.

lines.speaker: The Echo
lines.text: That isn't an accusation. Somebody wrote those rules. That counts as being there.

lines.speaker: Bard
lines.text: ...That's the kindest thing anyone has ever said about autobattle.

lines.speaker: The Echo
lines.text: It's the only thing anyone has said about it here. Vertex is small.
